ambiguities.reason: Two different funding splits are stated: platform festive campaign is 60% platform / 40% seller, while seller-elected campaigns are 60% seller / 40% platform. Orders qualifying under both are 'funded under both clauses', which is not a single coherent split. The extracted values assume the platform festive campaign; the seller-elected split differs.
ambiguities.source_quote: Discounts under the Platform's festive campaign shall be funded 60% by the Platform. Discounts under any seller-elected campaign shall be funded 60% by the Seller. Where an order qualifies under both campaigns the discount shall be funded under both clauses.
